response.sql:
WITH album_rates AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS bytes_per_millisecond_rate
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
overall_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond_rate) AS average_rate_across_albums
  FROM album_rates
)
SELECT
  ar.AlbumId,
  ar.average_unit_price,
  ar.bytes_per_millisecond_rate,
  ar.bytes_per_millisecond_rate - o.average_rate_across_albums AS difference_above_average
FROM album_rates AS ar
CROSS JOIN overall_rate AS o
ORDER BY difference_above_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average rate across albums gives each AlbumId group, including the NULL AlbumId group, equal weight; NULL rates are ignored. Zero milliseconds is treated as an undefined rate and ignored.
